subject: ela
intro: Pick the main idea or detail.

items.prompt:
You hear: 'Recycling helps the earth. It saves trees.'

The main idea is:
A) Recycling helps the earth
B) Trees are tall
C) Trash is heavy

A fact that supports the main idea is a:
A) detail
B) title
C) cover

To remember what you hear, you should:
A) listen carefully
B) stop listening
C) talk over it

You hear: 'Exercise keeps your body strong and your heart healthy.'

One supporting detail is:
A) It keeps your heart healthy
B) Exercise is a word
C) I like naps
items.answer: A) It keeps your heart healthy

solution.answer: A) It keeps your heart healthy

items.prompt:
You watch a video about bees moving pollen so plants can grow. The main idea is:
A) Bees help plants grow
B) Bees are yellow
C) Flowers smell nice

The MAIN IDEA of a message is:
A) what it is mostly about
B) one tiny detail
C) the last word
items.answer: A) what it is mostly about

solution.answer: A) what it is mostly about

items.prompt:
You hear: 'Sea turtles travel thousands of miles. They return to the same beach to lay eggs. This long trip is amazing.'

The main idea is:
A) Sea turtles make an amazing long journey
B) Beaches have sand
C) Eggs are small
items.answer: A) Sea turtles make an amazing long journey

steps: Ties the details together. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Sea turtles make an amazing long journey

items.prompt:
While listening to a long talk, the BEST way to keep the main idea and details is to:
A) take short notes as you listen
B) daydream
C) only watch the pictures
items.answer: A) take short notes as you listen

steps: Notes aid memory. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) take short notes as you listen
